purpose: Genuine Bazel 9.3.1 capture of depsets whose struct/provider elements hold functions that are not top-level defs (closures, lambdas, nested defs; skylib DirectoryInfo shape as rules_cc cc_args uses it): identity equality and dedup in every order, calls after to_list(), a dependency's pre-freeze depset combined with its frozen struct and closure, this implementation's closures before and (in a consumer) after the freeze, struct method values, .bzl top-level depsets across garbage-collecting statements, and the mutable built-in/bound-method errors. Evidence only.

reports.reference_outputs: closures_expected.txt (each target's bazel-bin/dc/<name>.txt after a `== <name>` line)

errors.//dc:bad_bound_method: Error in depset: depset elements must not be mutable values
errors.//dc:bad_builtin_element: Error in depset: depset elements must not be mutable values
errors.//dc:bad_dict_get: Error in depset: depset elements must not be mutable values
errors.native: error: depset elements must not be mutable values (tests/depset_structs.rs element_checks_and_gaps)

N49 G/lambda_field.native: equal (the N49 declared gap of reference_receipt.json is closed)

kept_ctx.native: exit 1: unsupported provider payload ... captured the rule context `ctx`, which the native profile cannot freeze (declared gap: ctx cannot be frozen natively)

findings: Every Starlark function is immutable (StarlarkFunction.isImmutable); equality is the per-instantiation token: twins with equal fields and distinct lambdas are 2 elements, one provider instance twice is 1.
A dependency's depset built before its freeze deduplicates against the same closures and struct read from its frozen provider (dep_combined=2, top=2).
Built-in functions and bound methods ("x".upper, {}.get, len) are rejected as mutable.
Closures capturing ctx in discarded depsets (//dc:tr) and in a returned provider's depset (//dc:bad_kept_ctx) are both accepted.
